metadata.audit_title: Prompt 21 Citation Failure Forensic Analysis & Provenance Repair
metadata.investigation_scope: Audit and remediation of the 36 MISSING_OR_UNRESOLVED citations reported in Prompt 20

JAEGER.description: Distributed tracing span summaries synthesized from error logs or collected from Jaeger telemetry.

TOPOLOGY.description: Architectural dependency edges derived by ServiceTopologyGraph.

missing_trace_registration_in_known_sets.mechanism: EvidenceCitationValidator.audit_investigation populated known_telemetry_source_ids solely from raw_telemetry.get('metrics', []). Traces synthesized from logs or provided in telemetry snapshots were never added to known_telemetry_ids.

inverted_fallback_guard_in_validator.mechanism: EvidenceCitationValidator.validate_single_item guarded trace- prefix matching with `(not has_known_sets and ...)`. Whenever metric signals were present (making has_known_sets=True), valid Jaeger traces were rejected as MISSING_OR_UNRESOLVED.

topology_prefix_omission_in_derived_anal.mechanism: EvidenceCitationValidator.validate_single_item checked is_derived_analysis for 'anomaly-', 'corr-', 'rca-', but omitted 'topo-' and source_type == 'TOPOLOGY', rejecting architectural dependency citations.

silent_import_failure_in_db_audit.mechanism: EvidenceCitationValidator.audit_investigation attempted to import `from backend.app.agent.db.models import Event`. The Event model resides in `backend.app.ingestion.db.models`. The resulting ImportError was caught in a broad try/except block, silently preventing database events from being used for citation verification.

item_level_audit_of_the_36_unresolved_ci.cause: Trace ID not registered in known_telemetry_ids; blocked by inverted has_known_sets guard.
